name: @pipeworx/mcp-quickgo

tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: QuickGO (EBI) — search Gene Ontology (GO) terms by keyword. Returns matching GO terms (id + name) for a free-text query like "apoptosis". Keyless.

query.description: Free-text keyword to search GO terms, e.g. "apoptosis".

tools.name: get_term
tools.description: QuickGO (EBI) — get a single Gene Ontology (GO) term by id. Returns its name, aspect (biological_process|molecular_function|cellular_component), definition, synonyms, and obsolete flag. Keyless.

tools.name: gene_annotations
tools.description: QuickGO (EBI) — list the Gene Ontology (GO) annotations for a gene/protein, identified by UniProt accession (e.g. "P04637"). Returns GO ids, names, aspect, evidence, and taxon. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-quickgo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the quickgo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
